summary: scripts/st-test runs each heavy check (linux-gate, mail-redelivery-canaries) under one heavy-slot ticket from the cargo admission shim (--stage-slot) inside a builds.slice scope, so heavy runs queue behind the host's slots and every compile they start is slice-bound; the signed command is unchanged.

replay.detail: st-test's heavy checks only; no protocol, schema, policy, workflow or note change.

schema.detail: st-test's heavy checks only; no protocol, schema, policy, workflow or note change.

rules.detail: st-test's heavy checks only; no protocol, schema, policy, workflow or note change.

compatibility.detail: A host without the shim or a user systemd bus runs the checks as before and says so.

downtime.detail: st-test's heavy checks only; no protocol, schema, policy, workflow or note change.

manual.detail: None. The shim stops a stage after CARGO_STAGE_MAX_SECONDS (default 2400 s); a different value for st-test's stage is a decision for Operations and Nathan, not part of this change.

recovery.detail: ST_EVIDENCE_GOVERN=off runs the heavy checks as before.
